title: Caveman route ask v1
description: The body a signed-in local runtime posts to Cloud's POST /v1/route: the caller's models and counts computed on the machine. No prompt text, file contents or headers. The tenant comes from the bearer token, never from the body. Cloud answers with one of the models, or the runtime keeps the asked one.

models.description: The model the agent asked for first, then the other models of the same provider it may move to.

agent.description: The wrapped agent: claude, codex, …; unlabeled-agent when unknown.

tool_errors.description: Tool results in the request marked as errors.
